newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Britain's CCL Oil wins Kazakh refinery tender.
newsitem.headline: Britain's CCL Oil wins Kazakh refinery tender.

text.p: British company CCL Oil has won a tender for Kazakhstan's state-owned Pavlodar oil refinery, a State Property Committee spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
She declined to give details of the terms of the tender, saying only that more information would be made available in the next few days.
The spokeswoman said CCL was registered in Britain.

Other bidders were Canada's Hurricane Hydrocarbons Ltd, Britain's Inter-Mediterranean Petroleum Co UK Ltd, Access Industries of the United States and Kazakhstan's Amaday and Radical, a committee spokesman told Reuters in January.
The Pavlodar refinery, in the north of the oil-rich nation and close to the Russian border, has a capacity of around 7.5 million tonnes a year, according to official figures.
The sale is part of a wider sell-off of most of Kazakhstan's energy enterprises.
